subject: Re: Kickoff: Anthea — MQM translation quality evaluation
body:
Anders,

Staffing: Paloma 50% on deployment and template config, Vera 40% on the rater calibration protocol, Hyun 20% advisory on MQM scoring methodology. There is no shared place to publish MQM scores, so we're scoping and staffing a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch — Efe at 45% owns it, first internal version by late March.

Infra is trivially small — anthea.html plus the eval/manager CSS and JS off a static server, no GPUs at all. The one dependency is the Marot files from the sibling project for score visualization; Paloma is mirroring those.

Real cost here is rater time, not compute: the calibration round needs ~120 rater-hours across three language pairs. That's the thing to protect.

Bao
